### 🎃👻 **BOLLYWOOD HALLOWEEN PARTY** 👻🎃

✨ **Austin, Get Ready for a Spooktacular Bollywood Night!** ✨

This Halloween, we’re taking over **Maggie Mae’s in Downtown Austin** for a night of **Bollywood beats, spooky vibes, killer costumes & nonstop dancing!** 🕺💃🔥

🎧 **Music by DJ SHER** 

🎉 **Presented by Livvie Star Company @LivvieStarCompany | @TheLivvieStarShow** 

📍 **Maggie Mae’s — Downtown Austin** 

📅 **Saturday, October 31** 

⏰ **10 PM – 2 AM**

🕸️ **WHAT TO EXPECT:** 

🎶 Bollywood • Desi • Party Anthems 

👻 Halloween-themed atmosphere 

🎭 **Costumes HIGHLY encouraged!** 

💃 Nonstop dancing 

🍸 Drinks & nightlife vibes 

🔥 Downtown Austin energy all night long!

🧛‍♀️ **COME DRESSED TO IMPRESS… OR SCARE!** 🧛‍♂️ 

Whether you’re going full Bollywood glam, spooky, sexy, funny, or totally outrageous — **bring your Halloween alter ego!** 🎃✨

Grab your crew, put on your best costume and get ready to **Dance. Drink. Repeat**.🥂💃
